Worker recovery rule/provenance, from Fable2/session-8112 mailbox5855 #1456, mailbox-message-4cd8a3d5-9509-40a4-8956-60554b3b03e6, 2026-10-25T23:43:51.183677800Z. Exact wording: "STANDING RULE, from now on and for every lane, so you need not ask next time: when a Codex review follow-up fails with \"timed out waiting for Codex app-server response to `thread/unarchive`\", the producer replaces it with ONE fresh Codex whole-input reviewer on the same frozen input, records the occurrence on w-54b31236feca, and states it in the READY. No retries of the failed thread and no Kimi stand-in. It does not apply to any other failure." Read the whole source message before applying. This records coordinator operational recovery of a known per-thread host defect, not a vendor-outage substitute or general authority widening. Keep the other vendor's current attempt; require replacement's own authoritative submission, ALL prose, final-path coverage and native before/after identity. No incomplete READY and no failed-thread retry loop.

Historical notes remain linked; current occurrence evidence is d383 note66de9f98eeb649a58f0109ff47f0d1f0. The recovery procedure and its authority are unchanged.
